text: If it is said that the enjoyment of the Lord and the individual soul is the same because they reside in the same body, that is not so, due to the difference in their powers. As stated in the Garuda Purana: “Due to the difference between omniscience and limited knowledge, between omnipotence and limited power, and between absolute independence and dependence, the enjoyment of the Lord and the individual soul is not the same.”
